tool: gpt-image 스킬(Codex 내장 image_gen, ChatGPT 구독 인증)
prompt:
Full-body front view of a creature design for 3D modelling. A tall, thin humanoid creature for a Korean apartment horror game, about 2.2 metres tall, standing completely still. Its whole body is built out of the paper that piles up on the steel front doors of old Korean apartments: faded takeout menu flyers, small round delivery fridge magnets, white gas-inspection stickers, yellow missed-parcel notice slips and torn real-estate leaflets, layered and overlapping like shingles, some corners curling and lifting, a few sheets creased and slightly water-stained. Narrow sloping shoulders, a long thin neck, very long thin arms made of rolled and folded flyers hanging almost to the knees, slightly away from the body. It has no visible legs or feet: below the waist the papers hang down in long overlapping strips like a heavy coat that just brushes the floor. Where a face should be there is only one round red-and-white fried-chicken delivery magnet stuck on slightly crooked, with no eyes, nose or mouth. Muted realistic paper colours: off-white, pale yellow, faded red, light grey, a little sky blue. All printing on the papers is soft illegible colour blocks and simple abstract pictograms, with no readable letters or numbers. Facing the camera, centred, the whole figure in frame with space around it.
Scene/backdrop: a perfectly flat solid #00ff00 chroma-key background. The background must be one uniform color with no shadows, gradients, texture, reflections, floor plane, lighting variation, or scenery.
Constraints: do not use #00ff00 or any green reflected spill anywhere on the subject; crisp silhouette suitable for chroma removal; generous green padding around the silhouette; no part of the subject cut off by the frame edge; no text, no labels, no numbers, no watermark, no logo, no border, no cast shadow on the green background.
Rendering discipline (critical): resolve every surface with gentle continuous gradients, never with fine dots. Absolutely no per-pixel noise of any kind: no stippling, no dithering, no halftone or screen-door pattern, no pointillist speckle, no sand or dust overlay, no crosshatch, no chromatic speckle, no oversharpened edge halos, no JPEG mosquito artifacts, no added film grain. Prefer slightly soft over crunchy; if uncertain, make it smoother. Restrained detail that still reads at 512 px. Soft neutral cool light on the subject only, no rim light, no bloom, no colour grading, no depth of field, no motion blur, no baked contact shadow.
usage: 문 밖 손님(종이 몸)의 몸. 원기둥에 종이를 붙여 두었던 몸을 바꾼다. 4분의 3 각도 안과 같이 뽑아 정면 쪽을 골랐다. 발이 없고 아래가 종이 자락으로 바닥에 닿아 지금처럼 미끄러지듯 움직여도 어색하지 않다. TRELLIS 생성 → 어둑시니와 같은 방식(rig_eoduksini)으로 허리를 숙이게 한다.
